name: Gegemoon 3D Teeth Whitening Strips | Professional 7-Day Whitening Kit | Enamel Safe Whitening Strips | Deep Stain Removal | Mint Flavor | 7 Pairs
description:
Achieve a brighter, whiter smile with Gegemoon 3D Teeth Whitening Strips. Designed with an advanced whitening formula, these professional whitening strips penetrate deep into the tooth surface to help reduce stains caused by coffee, tea, tobacco, wine, and everyday foods. The flexible strips comfortably fit both upper and lower teeth, providing secure adhesion for effective whitening while remaining gentle on enamel. With a refreshing mint flavor and easy 30-minute application, this 7-day whitening kit is a convenient way to enhance your smile from the comfort of your home.

Key Features
Professional 7-day teeth whitening treatment
Advanced whitening formula helps reduce deep stains
Helps remove stains from coffee, tea, tobacco, and wine
Enamel-safe formula for gentle whitening
Flexible strips fit both upper and lower teeth
Strong adhesive technology for a secure fit
Refreshing mint flavor for a clean feeling
Easy 30-minute daily application
Comfortable, mess-free peel-and-apply design
Suitable for home teeth whitening routine

Product Specifications
Brand: Gegemoon
Product Type: Teeth Whitening Strips
Quantity: 7 Pairs (14 Strips)
Net Weight: 2.5g (Approx.)
Flavor: Mint
Treatment Duration: 7 Days

How to Use
Brush and dry your teeth before application
Open the foil pouch with dry hands
Remove the upper and lower whitening strips from the backing
Apply the gel side to your teeth and align with the gum line
Press gently and fold the remaining strip behind the teeth
Leave on for approximately 30 minutes
Remove and discard the strips
Rinse your mouth after use
Use one pair daily to complete the treatment

Material / Composition
Glycerin
Propylene Glycol
Aqua (Water)
Sodium Phytate
Carbomer
Cellulose Gum
PVP
Glucose
Sodium Hydroxide

Safety Information
For oral use only
Do not swallow the strips
Not suitable for children under 12 years of age
Not recommended for pregnant women
Do not use on irritated gums or mouth ulcers
Avoid contact with eyes
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
Keep out of reach of children
